profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform
profile.summary: As a Systems Engineer oriented towards the software automation processes, I am focused in providing automation solutions that can improve the efficiency and speed in routine processes. The main technologies I am working on are Python, Django, Java and Selenium.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• API Architecture & Security: Spearheaded the development of critical APIs (Guest Preferences, Travel Fare Pricing) in GCP, implementing comprehensive security through JWT authentication at APIM policies and application levels. Enhanced the Price Drop API with advanced features including cabin recommendations and next destination predictions, driving a projected revenue of $700,000 USD for 2024.
• Streaming Data Pipeline Architecture: Designed and implemented cloud-native solutions in GCP utilizing Pub/Sub and Dataflow for real-time data processing from Tealium streaming engine. Architected and deployed multi-stage data transformation pipelines through CI/CD terraform automation, enabling features like abandoned search analysis and fare alerts. 
• Cloud Infrastructure & API Integration: Architected and implemented serverless infrastructure for the User Match API using GCP Cloud Functions and Redis MemoryStore. Established secure service communication through in-transit encryption. Deployed complete infrastructure using Terraform and automated deployment pipelines.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Worked for Alaska Air Group project and some of my day to day activities were:

• Creating personalized profiles with machine learning models via Azure ML studio.
• Building data pipelines that connect Data Factories and Databricks notebooks with Tableau dashboards.
• Writing Azure functions written in NodeJS and Python that delivers json data to APIs such as Optimizely.
• Creating data pipelines with ARM templates and manage them through a CI/CD workflow.
• Creating connectors for moving data from Azure Data Lakes to Big Query.
• Created QA test suites with Python for validating the data that is send to different APIs.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Created Java and Python automation modules for the Cisco Network System Orchestrator (NSO). 
• Configured libraries for detecting the existing IoT devices, configurations and current network topology in an IoT MQTT broker style.
• Used Test Driven Approach for developing the application and implemented unit tests using Python Unit Test Framework in PyUnit. 
• Main developer of the High Level MAAPI (Management Agent API) which allows the communication between the NSO and web services hosted in Amazon EC2.

The main function of the DC and DCT is to communicate the Data Centers infrastructure through virtualized services orchestrated by the NSO.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Worked with IT auditors in the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) compliance that guarantees internal controls and fulfillment of other regulations to ERP systems in order to prevent any deceptive or fraudulent data reported to the Stock Market. 
• Acted as the main developer of an Incident Ticket Recommender System for the IT department. 
• Created and transformed existing data models into Django ORM models and created different templates, views, forms and signals in order to process the different requests for our users. 
• Created a CI/CD pipeline in order to automate the workflow of the project with Jenkins and Kubernetes.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Tech lead of an in-house web analytics API developed in Django. 
• Connected the API with Microsoft SQL 2012 and Cassandra NoSQL databases. The purpose was to assess engineers’ performance across the different countries of Central America (Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Colombia).
• Implemented backend asynchronous task queue system for data processing pipelines using the libraries DjangoCelery and RabbitMQ. 
• Worked on a Microsoft IIS 6.0 deployment for hosting the web application with MS SQL Server and Cassandra DB.

positions.title: Associate Product Support Analyst
positions.description:
1. Responsible for working with the North American Technical Support Team that handles technical problems related to the ERP SyteLine/ CloudSuite Business Industrial.  
2. Performed customizations in some of the SyteLine 8 and Infor CloudSuite modules through Java 8.
3. Acted as a developer modifying Stored Procedures, Triggers and Tables of the system through PL/SQL and created complex SQL queries for performing various CRUD operations

positions.title: Asistente de Coordinación de Tecnologías en Comunicación
positions.description:
1. I performed web development and system administration of the several websites, which included security updates and patch development.
2. Developed websites in HTML5, CSS3 and JS ES6 for the different faculties and departments of the university and integrated them with our main CMS (Joomla).
3. Utilized MySQL database to perform various CRUD operations to the CMS.

positions.title: Globalink Research Intern
positions.description: I participated as a Globalink Research Intern under supervision of Dr. Kinshuk, Dr. Ting Wen Chang and Dr. Sabine Graf on the field of Associative Learning Skills. During the internship we produced a scientific paper under the name of Towards the Research of Possible Assessment Tools of Associative Learning Skills which was selected on the 9th International Conference of Signal Image and Internet Technologies in Kyoto, Japan. DOI: 10.1109/SITIS.2013.165

positions.title: Web system developer
positions.description: I designed and coded a whole web administration system in order to automatize the registration process of the program dubbed as "Cuentame tu sueño" (make my wish).
